The artefact runs with $P(a) = \infty$, so every figure in Chapter 5 is the case without proactive invalidation.

old: The TEHDAS2 Joint Action's guideline for Health Data Access Bodies on procedures and formats for data access specifies a deletion deadline. Electronic health data must be deleted from a Secure Processing Environment within six months of the expiry of the data permit, under Article 68(12) of the European Health Data Space Regulation (TEHDAS2, 2025; European Parliament and Council of the European Union, 2025). This is a ceiling rather than a floor. After the six-month window, only anonymised analytical results may continue to exist outside the Secure Processing Environment, and the permitted data are not to remain within it. The same TEHDAS2 deliverable specifies a five-phase user journey for data access that ends in a deletion event marking the closure of the permitted processing.
